name: enable_object_damage

stack.evidence: func_001EBB50 consumes one object ID, resolves it through func_001EAB00, queues two object operations when found, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_001EBB50 queues operation types 0x23 and 0x2A for the resolved object. Both map to embedded DAMAGE_ON entries and clear the corresponding damage-disable flags. This is the explicit-object counterpart of command 335 enable_script_object_damage and the inverse of command 376 disable_object_damage. The JP corpus contains 142 calls.
